thread:
Raj Patel: @emma FYI — we're getting a customer p99 spike after the auth rollout. Support ticket TKT-4321. p95 stable but p99 jumped ~800ms -> 3.2s. Any ideas?

Emma Liu: seeing same in console, per-route p99 up. Traces show a ton of tiny microbatches (size=1) and lots of immediate retries.

Liam O'Connor: digging into traces — auth middleware returning intermittent 401s for acme-app, client retries flood front-end, batcher ends up emitting many size=1 batches which amplifies tail.

Support Bot: ticket TKT-4321 created by maya@acme.com — impacted region us-west-2 — 12:15 UTC

Maya SRE: snippet from prod trace/logs:
```
2025-03-02T12:14:58Z auth: 401 token_expired user=acme-app
2025-03-02T12:14:58Z client: retrying request id=abc123
2025-03-02T12:14:58Z batcher: emit batch size=1 wait_ms=120
```

Raj Patel: that chain explains it — intermittent 401 -> client retry -> tiny batch -> higher hold/wait jitter -> p99 spike. Quick mitigation: reduce max_wait_ms and nudge toward larger batches. Proposed immediate changes: set `batcher.max_wait_ms=80` and `batcher.max_batch_size=16` on canary nodes.

Emma Liu: also propose server-side quick-fallback for 401: worker attempts token refresh instead of letting client retry. Patch ready: `auth: try-refresh-on-401`.

Liam O'Connor: ran quick staging experiment with these three steps: 
1) `batcher.max_wait_ms=80`
2) `batcher.max_batch_size=16`
3) `auth.refresh_on_401=true`
Deployed to canary group — p99 dropped from ~3.2s -> ~600ms within 15m.

Raj Patel: rolling to customer-facing canary at 12:50 UTC. Also adding short-term tenant-level backpressure: if retries > 3 within 5s, throttle client path and return 429 with header `X-RW-Retry-Suggest`.

Support Bot: canary deployment succeeded on 3/3 hosts. Monitoring: p95 normal, p99 decreasing.

Maya SRE: long-term: fix auth token race, add server-side retry suppression, and batcher heuristic to prefer filling batches when arrivals look like retries. I'll open follow-up PR + postmortem.

Emma Liu: PR #891 opened: `suppress-retries-on-transient-auth` — adds tests and metric `auth_transient_retry_count`.

Raj Patel: draft customer note: "We identified intermittent auth failures causing client retries which created many tiny batches and increased p99. We deployed a mitigation and p99 is back to acceptable levels. Full fix rolling out next week." @Maria can you send?

Maria Gomez: will send update in 30m with the canary results and next steps.

Maya SRE: postmortem TODOs:
- root cause: investigate auth-service clock skew/rate limiter misbehavior
- batcher: add heuristic to prefer batch size when many singletons arrive
- alert: small-batch-rate > 10% triggers paging rule

Liam O'Connor: attached logs + traces to ticket: https://redwood.atlassian/issue/TKT-4321/logs

Emma Liu: thanks team :thumbsup:

Raj Patel: closing thread, will update when postmortem published.
